{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.299

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.299
    | text      = So I used to love Duncan Trussell.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.980
    | text      = Yeah, that was fun.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:08.379
    | text      = Back in a time when Joe Rogan's podcast really was just drunk or stoned comedians telling
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.259
    | text      = mostly untrue stories, Duncan was the one who seemed the coolest to me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:18.539
    | text      = Rogan himself was a jock and he seemed like the type who was prone to violence.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.539
    | text      = Joey Diaz was a creepy old dude who clearly didn't respect other people's boundaries,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.860
    | text      = but could tell an amazing mostly untrue story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.860
    | text      = God, he could tell a great story.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:31.419
    | text      = Bert Kreischer was an aging alcoholic who seemed like he'd be fun to party with for
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.259
    | text      = a night and he could tell an amazing mostly untrue story really well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:40.820
    | text      = But past a day, I don't know if I want to be around that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:44.340
    | text      = Nope, too many times to see a man take a shirt off.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:47.899
    | text      = Ari Shafir seemed like a bully and for the most part Tom Sakura seemed fine, but whatever.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.940
    | text      = But Duncan was different.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:55.779
    | text      = I'm not sure I've ever seen him do a set of stand-up and if I have, I certainly don't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:00.059
    | text      = remember his material.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:14.220

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = that you're using are heightened and not true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:23.419
    | text      = Even though I wasn't actually sure what it was that Duncan did that was so great, it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:27.980
    | text      = was clear to me that he felt special.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:30.820

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:32.299

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:36.700
    | text      = of his orbit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:37.779

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}
